stem.text: Two wires, P and Q, made of the same material, are stretched with an increasing force.
A graph is plotted of the variation with force of the extension of each wire.

stem.alt: Graph of extension in mm against force in N, with two straight lines from the origin labelled P and Q. Axis values: extension 0 to 4, force 0 to 2.

stem.text: The wires have the same original length but different diameters.
What is the ratio $\dfrac{\text{diameter of wire Q}}{\text{diameter of wire P}}$?
